remaining_tasks.name: Event Video Title Cards
remaining_tasks.notes: Design sketched in conversation; needs /gsd-new-phase to formalise

decisions.decision: Title card inserted between intro clip and footage, ~3s duration
decisions.rationale: User wants context frame (location/date/event) before the video plays — richer than HUD burn-in

decisions.decision: Use Pillow to render PNG + ffmpeg loop to MP4, concat via existing demuxer list
decisions.rationale: Pillow gives full typographic control (kerning, coloured event badges, rounded corners) that drawtext cannot; reuses the existing concat-demuxer infrastructure in ring_buffer._concatenate_segments

decisions.decision: Reuse reverse_geocoder already wired in engine.py:776-782 and timelapse_compiler.py:92-115
decisions.rationale: No new dependency; offline-first; place-name resolution already works

decisions.decision: Reuse website event-colour palette (HIGH_G #da3633, BIG_CORNER #d29922, HARD_BRAKE #f85149, ROUGH_ROAD #8957e5, MANUAL #238636, BOOT #1f6feb)
decisions.rationale: Visual consistency across video, dashboard, Grafana, public site

next_action: Open a fresh session and run /gsd-new-phase to formalise 'Event Video Title Cards' as Phase 26. Feed in the design sketch from .continue-here.md Open Design Calls section as the starting brief.
